items.title: «Victory's Desolation» Published for Concert Band
items.teaser: Movement III from Suite for Concert Band is now available with full score, parts, and score video.
items.body:
The piece portrays Marko on the battlefield after striking down his beloved Adriane—sorrowful, violent, mad, yet sustained by hope.

Premiered by Ulefoss Musikkorps at the 2025 Anniversary Revue. Arranged for Grade 3.5 with flexible instrumentation and extensive cross-cueing.

items.title: «Market in Lydia» Available for Concert Band
items.teaser: Movement II from Suite for Concert Band. A lively and spirited concert march in Grade 2.5.
items.body: A standalone concert march capturing the bustling marketplace atmosphere from the opera-musical Marko and Adriane. Premiered by Ulefoss Musikkorps in autumn 2025.

items.title: Score Exchange Selected for Digital Sheet Music Distribution
items.teaser: Complete conductor scores and instrument part sets are now distributed digitally via Score Exchange.
items.body:
To ensure immediate, reliable access for wind bands, conductors, and ensembles worldwide, Score Exchange has been established as the primary digital distribution channel.

The platform provides instant delivery of full scores and complete part sets with authorized direct printing rights.

items.title: Official Launch of geirsolerod.no
items.teaser: New official composer website launched featuring full works catalogue, audio samples, and score requests.
items.body:
Welcome to the official website of composer, lyricist, and arranger Geir Solerød.

The site brings together works for full symphony orchestra, concert band, musical theatre, choir, and studio archives in one place, offering direct access to study scores and licensing inquiries.
